notes.title: Abracadabrew is now Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/2e4983f8dcc523e8699ed65672c397dd25420fab.jpg

We are really excited to announce we have completed the Early Access developpment of our magical & witchy couch co-op game Abracadabrew right on time for Halloween!

Thank you all so much for all the help and support you gave us during these last two weeks of improvements! Whether you've been with us all through Early Access or just now joining us, we hope you have a wonderful time experiencing the challenges our magic world has to offer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/a930a959834025656850c9c820b902aade337cdf.gif


How to Get the Launch Update
This update is a free, automatic download for Early Access players. If you've come directly to this post, check out the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233250/Abracadabrew/


About the Game
Abracadabrew is a memory-based 1-4 player local co-op game. Cooperate with your friends while using your memory to brew as many potions as you can by dawn. Gather ingredients hidden around the room while communicating and staying focused to unlock new brain-racking potion combinations!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/f4a11e0214e94fc96df39c3a525ef890b39f81cb.gif


If you want to know more or participate testing features before release, please join us on Miju's official Discord server:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/2ba620d56659eac7d26995c65486df7eca037f48.jpg

Thank you!

notes.title: Abracadabrew Official Release Date
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After nearly a year of development, we are really happy to announce that 

Abracadabrew will be released on October 14th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/6fabb4045e6f99828a5e2a94d443a0c2c7fca6c2.gif

First of all, we want to address our warmest thanks to all of you who supported us, tested the game and helped us improve Abracadabrew for the last few months. We received a lot of positivity from you guys and it was a strong motivation to keep us on doing our best with the development. So THANK YOU!

The official release would not be complete without a major update and we spent the summer on bug fixing / polishing as well as creating new content. So you'll find a lot of changes in the game such as more vibrant maps, a "bat flock attack" event, new potions combinations, new tunes or a star-based level completion system.


Hope you'll like it!


See you on Steam on October 14th or sooner on our Discord server :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/7d1ea595116a7d7ddbbf7ad53700b86626a1a1e2.jpg




Full changelog

Game

 3 New maps!
- "Standing Stone Arch"
- "Magic Greenhouse" 
- "Crystal Cave"
 A distinctive colored circle under each player
 Cabinets highlight when the session starts
 New event: Bats everywhere!
 Teleport portal system!
New combinations for ingredients: 
- A specific color, but not a specific shape (ex: something blue, but not a batwing)
- A specific shape, but not a specific color (ex: a tentacle, but not yellow)
- Not a specific shape, and not a specific color (ex: not a tentacle, and not blue)
 New stars system: every level have now 3 stars to unlock
Improved stars animation at the end of the level
Improved sound effects at the end of level
Added more particles effects on maps
Number of stars displayed in level list for a quick readability of your progression


Technical

 Improved map loading to reduce VRAM usage
 Witches move a little bit faster
 New Language: traditional Chinese

notes.title: "The spider's lair update" is now available!
notes.content:

Get ready to fight the monstrous Arachnea Queen in its lair.
We updated the game with a lot of new content such as:

10 new ingredients to spice things up
Several mini-events to make your sessions more chaotic
We did our best to improve a lot of small details and balance difficulty

We hope you will enjoy it!

Feel free to tell us what you would like to see in the next updates as we'd like to improve Abracadabrew as much as possible.

Full changelog : 

Update 1.2

Game : 
    New boss mechanics : Health bar, attacks, animations, stunned effect
    New map : Spider's lair
    New boss : Arachnea Queen
    Added game events : Mini-Events randomly appear during game sessions
    Added 13 new ingredients

    Difficulty balance

notes.title: "Magical Update" is now available!
notes.content:

Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce that Abracadabrew's first update is now available!

According to your feedback, we improved different things such as: 

 New maps : A mystical library and a magic academy!
 New leaderboards system : you can now share your best scores and compete with the world!
 Difficulty : We balanced the difficulty of some levels to improve experience.
 Lots of technical improvements! (Controls, UI, loading, etc...)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/c42fd866d6cb4f5bceb09f4f24b659b0c1b4c860.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/4afaa2ce18e87711a45523109f8792bb9d483b10.jpg

We hope you will enjoy it!

Feel free to tell us what you would like to see in the next updates as we'd like to improve Abracadabrew as much as possible.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/c65829c6dea624a26f67e58e54cc62f8f03e6c33.png



Full changelog : 

Update 1.1.7  
    
Game : 
Two new maps : Mystical library and Magic academy
Improved gamepad deadzones. Resulting in better ingredient selection in cabinets. [Thanks to "Stelio Kontos" and "VANcLEEF"] 
Improved gamepad deadzones in players selection. [Thanks to "Stelio Kontos", "VANcLEEF", Kenji, and Simon]
New "Retry" button in pause menu
Leaderboards for each level
New particles effects on menus
Improved Level selection : The book opens up on the page of the last level
One second of "extra time" after the end of the timer
Type of controller now appears under player in player selection
Added volume control in options [Thanks to "Matours"] 
New languages : Japanese & Korean

Technical : 
If only one player is using keyboard, activate all inputs from keyboard (left / right)
Added post processing effects, like saturation, to make the game prettier
Force max FPS to 80
Activate Steam Cloud for saved data
New end screen just before quit
Added Version on start screen
Improved quality of levels backgrounds
Improved build process

notes.title: Abracadabrew now in Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/e503f13869716872d63196bdcc08ad11aa4583aa.png

Hello everyone,

After six months of work, Miju Games is proud to finally share Abracadabrew, our second game, with you!
We spent the last few weeks fixing bugs and adding the very last touch to this early version. So, warm up your brain, concentrate and get ready to communicate: it's time to brew potions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/6fabb4045e6f99828a5e2a94d443a0c2c7fca6c2.gif

The game will be in Early Access for the next few months, as we would love to add more content in the future such as:

Mini-games and random events during sessions
New playable characters
New environments
Even more challenging potions
Endless mode
Leaderboards


 To help us make the greatest content we can, we need your feedback. Don't be shy and tell us about your experience with the game and feel free to share all your crazy ideas!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038470/c65829c6dea624a26f67e58e54cc62f8f03e6c33.png
